tut.label: Tutorial
tut.welcome: Welcome to Boot Camp, recruit. In this game both sides take turns. On your turn, every soldier spends Action Points (AP) to move, turn and shoot.
tut.select.touch: Tap your soldier, Vega (the blue token), to select her.
tut.select.mouse: Click your soldier, Vega (the blue token), to select her.
tut.select.keyboard: Press Tab to select your soldier, Vega.
tut.select.gamepad: Press RB to select your soldier, Vega.
tut.ap: This panel shows Vega’s AP and health. Every step costs AP, and diagonal steps and turning cost a little more. AP refills at the start of each of your turns.
tut.move: Move next to the door at the marked tile.
tut.move.touch: Tap the marked tile. Green dots show a path you can afford. Tap the same tile again to move.
tut.move.mouse: Hover over the marked tile to see the path and AP cost, then click to move.
tut.move.keyboard: Use the arrow keys to move the cursor to the marked tile, then press {confirm} to move.
tut.move.gamepad: Use the d-pad to move the cursor to the marked tile, then press {confirm} to move.
tut.door: Doors open when you walk through them, which costs a little extra AP. Walk through it into the room to the north – you’ll stop automatically if you spot something.
tut.fog: Darkened tiles are outside your line of sight. Soldiers see in a wide arc in front of them, and enemies in the dark stay hidden – so facing matters!
tut.mode: There’s a training drone ahead. Pick a fire mode: Snap is quick, Aimed is accurate but costs more AP, and Auto fires a burst.
tut.mode.keyboard: There’s a training drone ahead. Pick a fire mode: {snap} Snap (quick), {aimed} Aimed (accurate, more AP).
tut.mode.gamepad: There’s a training drone ahead. Pick a fire mode: {snap} Snap (quick), {aimed} Aimed (accurate, more AP).
tut.fire.touch: Tap the drone to see your hit chance, then tap again to fire.
tut.fire.mouse: Hover the drone to see your hit chance, then click to fire.
tut.fire.keyboard: Move the cursor onto the drone to see your hit chance, then press {confirm} to fire.
tut.fire.gamepad: Move the cursor onto the drone to see your hit chance, then press {confirm} to fire.
tut.finish: Keep firing until the drone is down. Watch its health bar and the combat log. Out of AP? Press End turn ({endTurn}) – AP refills next turn.
codex.ap.title: Action points (AP)
codex.ap.body: Every soldier has a pool of AP that refills at the start of your turn. Moving, turning, opening doors and firing all cost AP. The HUD and the path preview always show what an action will cost before you commit.
codex.move.title: Movement
codex.move.body: A straight step costs 2 AP and a diagonal one costs 3. Rubble costs extra, and turning costs 1 AP per 45°. Movement stops automatically when a new enemy comes into view.
codex.facing.title: Facing
codex.facing.body: Soldiers see roughly 180° in front of them. Turn to cover a doorway or corridor before you end your turn.
codex.fog.title: Line of sight & fog
codex.fog.body: You only see what your soldiers see. Walls, crates and closed doors block sight, but windows don’t. Darkened tiles may hide enemies.
codex.fire.title: Fire modes
codex.fire.body:
Snap: fast and cheap, but less accurate.
Aimed: accurate, but expensive.
Auto: fires a burst of shots with lower accuracy each.
Hit chance drops with distance. Missed shots keep flying and can hit whatever is behind the target.
codex.reaction.title: Reaction fire
codex.reaction.body: AP left over at the end of your turn lets a soldier react during the enemy’s turn. The more AP is saved, the more likely they are to fire a snap shot at an enemy that moves into view.
codex.cover.title: Cover & destruction
codex.cover.body: Shots stop at the first wall, crate, door or soldier they hit. Enough damage destroys cover and leaves rubble – so blast a new path or strip an enemy’s protection.
codex.doors.title: Doors
codex.doors.body: Walking through a closed door opens it for +2 AP. Use the Door action to open or close an adjacent door without moving. Closing doors blocks line of sight.
codex.hotseat.title: Hotseat
codex.hotseat.body: Two players share one device. Between turns the screen is hidden, so pass the device and let the next player confirm they’re ready. You only ever see your own side’s view.
codex.controls.title: Controls
codex.controls.body:
Mouse: hover to preview, click to act, wheel to zoom.
Touch: tap to preview, tap again to confirm, pinch to zoom, long-press to inspect.
Keyboard: arrows + Enter, Tab to switch soldiers, 1/2/3 fire modes, E end turn.
Gamepad: d-pad + A, LB/RB to switch soldiers.
refresher.welcomeBack: Welcome back! It’s been {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Here’s a quick recap.
refresher.title: Quick refresher
bootcamp.firstSteps: Camera, selecting, action points, moving, doors, line of sight, facing and your first shots.
bootcamp.coverFire: Shots are physical: blast through cover, read the hit chance, and pick the right fire mode and range.
bootcamp.reaction: Turn saved AP into an ambush with reaction fire – and learn how to avoid walking into one.
bootcamp.squad: Lead three soldiers against live opponents: switching units, weapon roles, covering moves and focus fire.
bootcamp.hint: Each mission takes 3–5 minutes. You can replay any of them later from here – handy after a break.
tut.camera: First, look around the training ground.
tut.camera.touch: First, look around: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom.
tut.camera.mouse: First, look around: drag the map to pan, use the mouse wheel to zoom.
tut.camera.keyboard: First, look around: press + or − to zoom. The arrow keys move the cursor and the view follows it.
tut.camera.gamepad: First, look around: the d-pad moves the cursor and the view follows it. Press + or − on a keyboard to zoom.
tut.facing: Facing matters: soldiers only see in front of them. Turn Vega with the turn buttons – each 45° costs 1 AP.
tut.facing.keyboard: Facing matters: soldiers only see in front of them. Turn Vega with {turnLeft} / {turnRight} – each 45° costs 1 AP.
tut.facing.gamepad: Facing matters: soldiers only see in front of them. Turn Vega with the ⟲ ⟳ buttons – each 45° costs 1 AP. Moving and firing also turn her automatically.
tut.b2.intro: Shots in Squad Protocol are physical. Each bullet travels along a line and stops at the first wall, crate, closed door or soldier in its way – and misses keep flying until they hit something.
tut.b2.blocked: Something is hiding behind those crates – crates and walls block line of sight. Choose Snap fire and shoot the middle crate to blast it apart.
tut.b2.rubble: Target revealed! Destroyed cover leaves rubble: you can walk on it, but it costs +2 AP per step. Blasting your own path – or an enemy’s cover – is a powerful trick.
tut.b2.odds: Check the odds before you fire.
tut.b2.odds.touch: Tap the drone (don’t tap twice yet!) to preview your hit chance and AP cost.
tut.b2.odds.mouse: Hover over the drone to preview your hit chance and AP cost.
tut.b2.odds.keyboard: Move the cursor onto the drone to preview your hit chance and AP cost.
tut.b2.odds.gamepad: Move the cursor onto the drone to preview your hit chance and AP cost.
tut.b2.aimed: That’s a long shot. Switch to Aimed and look at the chance again: it costs twice the AP of Snap, but is far more accurate.
tut.b2.aimed.keyboard: That’s a long shot. Press {aimed} for Aimed and look at the chance again: it costs twice the AP of Snap, but is far more accurate.
tut.b2.closer: Hit chance drops with every tile beyond 3. Often the cheapest accuracy is getting closer: switch to Move and advance a few tiles toward the drone.
tut.b2.auto: Up close, Auto shines: it fires a 3-round burst and every round rolls separately – great for finishing a target. Snap is the most AP-efficient at medium range, and Aimed is best for long, important shots.
tut.b2.finish: Now destroy the drone (it takes about two hits). Experiment with modes and watch the preview. If you run out of AP, just end your turn.
tut.b3.intro: The most important trick in the game: AP you don’t spend is not wasted. During the enemy’s turn, a soldier with saved AP may automatically fire a snap shot at any enemy that moves into view. The chance equals the share of AP saved.
tut.b3.face: Something is moving beyond the open door. Turn Vega to face east, toward the marked doorway.
tut.b3.face.keyboard: Something is moving beyond the open door. Turn Vega to face east with {turnRight} (four times), toward the marked doorway.
tut.b3.wait: Now set the ambush: end your turn without spending more AP. Vega keeps almost all her AP as a reaction reserve.
tut.b3.debrief: Did you see a yellow tracer? That was Vega reacting on her own. Reaction fire is never guaranteed – the more AP saved, the more likely – but a soldier watching a doorway is a deadly trap.
tut.b3.enemyReserve: The enemy can do the same. Another drone in the east room saved all its AP last turn. Charging through its view invites reaction fire. Approach outside its view arc, use walls to break line of sight, or soften it up from cover first.
tut.b3.interrupt: Movement also stops automatically when a new enemy comes into view, so you keep the rest of your AP to respond. Long moves into the unknown are risky – advance in short hops.
tut.b3.finish: Clear the area: destroy both drones. Try to finish each turn with a reserve facing where trouble will come from.
tut.b4.intro: Time to lead a full squad. Every soldier has their own AP, and you can switch between them at any time during your turn – even halfway through a move plan.
tut.b4.switch.touch: Tap another blue soldier, or press Next, to select them.
tut.b4.switch.mouse: Click another blue soldier, or press Next, to select them.
tut.b4.switch.keyboard: Press {next} to switch to the next soldier.
tut.b4.switch.gamepad: Press {next} to switch to the next soldier.
tut.b4.roles: Weapons give soldiers roles. Lind’s marksman laser hits hard at long range but has no Auto mode. Marsh’s sidearm is light and cheap to fire, so he has more AP to move. Vega’s pulse rifle does a bit of everything.
tut.b4.overwatch: Bounding overwatch: move one soldier forward while the others stay back with a reaction reserve, ready to punish anyone who shoots at the runner. Move one soldier now.
tut.b4.flank: Flank! Cover only protects along the line of fire. Hit chance doesn’t account for crates and walls – but the bullet does. If a crate is in the way, find an angle with a clear line instead.
tut.b4.focus: Focus fire: a wounded enemy still shoots at full strength. Finishing one target is usually better than wounding three. Use the hit-chance preview from each soldier to pick the best shooter.
tut.b4.finish: Defeat the Red Cell. Watch the top bar for whose turn it is. Graduation awaits!
tips.title: Tips & tricks
tips.reserve.title: Always keep a reserve
tips.reserve.body: End turns with at least one snap shot’s worth of AP on soldiers facing likely threats. Saved AP is reaction fire during the enemy’s turn.
tips.facing.title: Face the danger
tips.facing.body: Soldiers only see – and react – in a 180° arc in front of them. Spend your last 1–2 AP turning toward doors, corridors or the last known enemy position.
tips.closer.title: Closer beats aiming
tips.closer.body: Hit chance drops by 3.5% for every tile beyond 3. Two steps forward often buy more accuracy than switching from Snap to Aimed – and cost less AP.
tips.aimedVsSnap.title: Snap or Aimed?
tips.aimedVsSnap.body: Snap is the most AP-efficient choice at short and medium range. Save Aimed for long shots, or for the one shot that must hit.
tips.autoClose.title: Auto for close quarters
tips.autoClose.body: Auto fires several rounds that roll separately. At point-blank range it can drop a wounded enemy with a single trigger pull.
tips.blastCover.title: Blast cover
tips.blastCover.body: Crates, doors and even walls can be shot apart. Strip an enemy’s cover, or open a new route instead of walking through a watched door.
tips.missesFly.title: Misses keep flying
tips.missesFly.body: A miss doesn’t vanish: it continues past the target and can hit cover or anyone standing behind. Mind what’s beyond your target.
tips.friendlyFire.title: Watch your line
tips.friendlyFire.body: Bullets hit the first soldier on their line – including your own. Don’t shoot past a squadmate standing in the way.
tips.doors.title: Doors are tactical tools
tips.doors.body: A closed door blocks sight. Close one (Door action, 2 AP) to break line of sight to an enemy, or open it at the end of your turn to set up an ambush.
tips.windows.title: Windows
tips.windows.body: You can see and shoot through windows but not walk through them. The first shot shatters the glass.
tips.spottedStop.title: Advance in short hops
tips.spottedStop.body: Movement stops when a new enemy appears, but every step you take in an enemy’s view can trigger its reaction fire. Short moves keep options open.
tips.peek.title: Peek from corners
tips.peek.body: Step out, shoot, and step back behind the wall in the same turn. An enemy that can’t see you can’t react to you.
tips.diagonals.title: Diagonals and turning
tips.diagonals.body: A diagonal step costs 3 AP and a straight one 2, and every 45° turn costs 1 AP. Paths that zig-zag can cost more than they look – check the preview.
tips.wounded.title: Pull back the wounded
tips.wounded.body: Health doesn’t regenerate. Move badly wounded soldiers out of sight and let them cover a doorway with their reserve instead.
tips.switchOften.title: Switch soldiers mid-turn
tips.switchOften.body: Move one soldier to spot an enemy, then let another with a better weapon take the shot. Spotting helps the whole squad.
tips.lastSeen.title: Use what you know
tips.lastSeen.body: Enemies out of sight are hidden but not gone. Remember where you last saw them, and turn to face that way at the end of your turn.
coach.title: Coach
coach.lowChance: Under 30% to hit. Try getting closer, switching to Aimed, or finding a better shooter – a miss can still hit cover behind the target.
coach.tooFar: Red dots mean you can’t afford the whole path. The soldier will stop at the last green dot.
coach.spotted: Movement stopped because a new enemy came into view. The rest of your AP is still there – shoot, take cover, or back off.
coach.enemyReaction: That was enemy reaction fire: the enemy saved AP and shot as you moved through its view. Approach watched areas from outside their arc, or from cover.
coach.ownReaction: Your soldier fired a reaction shot on their own, thanks to saved AP. Ending turns with a reserve sets these ambushes up.
coach.coverHit: Your miss hit cover instead. Keep shooting to destroy it, or find an angle with a clear line.
coach.noReserve: Nobody has enough AP left for a reaction shot this enemy turn. Next time, consider stopping a little earlier so someone can cover the squad.
coach.wounded: One of your soldiers is badly wounded. Health doesn’t regenerate – pull them out of sight and let them guard a doorway instead.
coach.unitLost: You lost a soldier. Short moves, reserves and facing toward threats help keep the squad alive.
over.missionNext: Well done. The next lesson builds on what you’ve just learned.
over.bootcampDone: You’ve finished Boot Camp – you’re ready for the real thing. Try a skirmish, and check How to play › Tips & tricks any time.
over.missionRetry: Training isn’t graded. Try again – each attempt plays out a little differently.
